es: Identificar la causa, el supuesto cultural y la mejor reacción en relatos de malentendidos entre culturas.

teaching.en: Many visitors assume that dinner is at nine, but this family eats at six.
teaching.es: Muchos visitantes suponen que la cena es a las nueve, pero esta familia cena a las seis.
teaching.explanationEs: Assume = suponer: creemos algo sin haberlo preguntado.
segments: Many visitors assume that dinner is at
nine, but this family eats at six.
teaching.audioText: Many visitors assume that dinner is at nine, but this family eats at six.

teaching.en: Tom felt embarrassed because he did not know the custom of bringing a small gift.
teaching.es: Tom se sintió avergonzado porque no conocía la costumbre de llevar un pequeño regalo.
teaching.explanationEs: Embarrassed describe cómo se siente la persona; embarrassing describe la situación.
segments: Tom felt embarrassed because he did not know
the custom of bringing a small gift.
teaching.audioText: Tom felt embarrassed because he did not know the custom of bringing a small gift.

teaching.en: When the host said “We will see,” Mia took it as a yes, and that caused a misunderstanding.
teaching.es: Cuando el anfitrión dijo «Ya veremos», Mia lo tomó como un sí, y eso causó un malentendido.
teaching.explanationEs: El supuesto de Mia no coincidía con el del anfitrión.
segments: When the host said “We will see,” Mia took
it as a yes, and that caused a misunderstanding.
teaching.audioText: When the host said “We will see,” Mia took it as a yes, and that caused a misunderstanding.

teaching.en: In some families silence is not rude; it is a way to show respect.
teaching.es: En algunas familias el silencio no es de mala educación; es una forma de mostrar respeto.
teaching.explanationEs: Lo que parece maleducado en una cultura puede ser cortesía en otra.
segments: In some families silence is not rude;
it is a way to show respect.
teaching.audioText: In some families silence is not rude; it is a way to show respect.

teaching.en: The exchange student did not take offence; her reaction was to ask a polite question.
teaching.es: La estudiante de intercambio no se ofendió; su reacción fue hacer una pregunta educada.
teaching.explanationEs: La mejor reacción suele ser preguntar con tacto, no acusar.
segments: The exchange student did not take offence; her
reaction was to ask a polite question.
teaching.audioText: The exchange student did not take offence; her reaction was to ask a polite question.

prompt.es: Lee el relato y elige la causa del malentendido.

choices.text: In their home, people do not wear shoes inside.
Tom arrived too early for dinner.
Tom did not bring a gift.

feedback.es: La familia no usa zapatos dentro de casa y Tom los lleva puestos: esa diferencia de costumbre causa la incomodidad.

hint.es: Fíjate en lo que hace Tom y en la costumbre de la familia.

origin.text: Tom visits a friend's home and keeps his shoes on. The family looks surprised. In their home, nobody wears shoes inside.

prompt.es: Completa: «Muchos visitantes suponen que la cena es tarde.»

feedback.es: Assume es el verbo para dar algo por hecho sin preguntar; con sujeto plural va sin -s.

hint.es: Es el verbo de creer algo sin preguntar; el sujeto es plural.

origin.text: Many visitors ___ that dinner is late.

prompt.es: Relaciona cada término con su significado.

pairs.es: lo que das por hecho sin preguntar
lo que una familia suele hacer
la persona que recibe a los invitados
incómodo por algo que has hecho

feedback.es: Un malentendido nace cuando el host y el visitante tienen una assumption distinta sobre una custom.

hint.es: Piensa en qué papel o sentimiento describe cada palabra.

pairs.es: lo que das por hecho sin preguntar
lo que una familia suele hacer
la persona que recibe a los invitados
incómodo por algo que has hecho

prompt.es: Lee el relato y elige el supuesto de Ana.

choices.text: She assumed that the host wanted no gift.
She assumed that a bigger gift is more polite.
She assumed that dinner was at seven.

feedback.es: Ana trae un regalo caro porque cree que un regalo grande es más educado; su anfitrión piensa lo contrario.

origin.text: Ana brings an expensive gift to a small family dinner. The host looks worried. In that family, a small gift is polite, and a big one creates pressure.

prompt.es: Escucha el relato y elige la mejor reacción de la madre anfitriona.

choices.text: The host mother should tell her to stop talking.
The family should ignore her for a week.
The host mother should ask kindly why she thanks so often.

feedback.es: Preguntar con amabilidad descubre el supuesto de la estudiante; ordenarle callar o ignorarla empeora el malentendido.

origin.audio: An exchange student says thank you every time her host family passes her the bread. The family thinks she is too formal and feels distant. In her country, saying thank you often is a sign of respect.

prompt.es: Ordena: «No me di cuenta de que era una costumbre de aquí.»

answer.text: I did not realise that it was a custom here

feedback.es: I did not realise that… presenta un supuesto equivocado que se descubre después.

prompt.es: Decide qué provocó la situación incómoda en la fiesta.

choices.text: Leo and the host had different ideas about arrival time.
Leo forgot the address of the party.
The host did not invite Leo.

feedback.es: Leo llegó a la hora indicada, pero la familia espera a los invitados más tarde: distinto supuesto sobre la hora.

origin.text: Leo arrives at eight for a party that starts at eight. The host is still cooking. In that family, guests usually arrive later than the time given.

prompt.es: Elige el supuesto de Mia en la reunión.

choices.text: Silence means the partner has no ideas.
Interrupting a speaker is rude.
A meeting must be very short.

feedback.es: Mia espera la pausa porque supone que interrumpir es de mala educación; la idea de que no tiene ideas es de su compañero.

origin.text: During a meeting, Mia waits for a pause before she speaks. Her partner thinks she has no ideas. Mia thinks that interrupting is rude.

prompt.es: Escucha el relato y elige la mejor reacción de la anfitriona.

choices.text: Tell the guest that he is rude.
Stop inviting guests to dinner.
Explain the custom kindly and ask about the guest's custom.

feedback.es: Explicar con amabilidad y preguntar por su costumbre evita el conflicto; acusar o cerrar la puerta no resuelve nada.

origin.audio: A guest from another country starts eating before everyone sits down. In the host family, everybody waits until the whole family is at the table.

prompt.es: Relaciona cada situación con el supuesto que la explica.

pairs: She takes photos at a quiet ceremony.
She calls her host by his first name.

pairs.es: supone que todos se tratan con confianza

pairs: They arrive with their whole family.

feedback.es: En cada caso el comportamiento parece extraño solo si no se conoce el supuesto de la persona.

pairs: She takes photos at a quiet ceremony.
She calls her host by his first name.

pairs.es: supone que todos se tratan con confianza

pairs: They arrive with their whole family.

prompt.es: Elige qué debería hacer Ana para ser cortés con su anfitriona.

choices.text: Accept a small amount of food and thank the host.
Refuse again more strongly.
Tell the host to stop serving.

feedback.es: Aceptar un poco y dar las gracias respeta la costumbre de la anfitriona sin ofenderla.

origin.text: Ana's host says, “Please, have more!” Ana says no twice, and the host keeps serving her. In the host's family, a guest who refuses is being polite, so the host must offer again.

prompt.es: Completa: «Me siento avergonzado porque llegué tarde.»

feedback.es: Con -ed se describe el sentimiento de la persona: embarrassed.

origin.text: I am ___ because I arrived late.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige el supuesto que causó el malentendido.

choices.text: The host assumed that Mia had a car.
Mia assumed that the host had said yes.
Mia assumed that the host lived nearby.

feedback.es: «We will see» fue interpretado por Mia como un sí; el anfitrión no lo decía así: ese supuesto causó la sorpresa.

origin.audio: Mia thought “We will see” meant yes. Her host meant that he was not sure. So Mia arrived with a suitcase, and the host was very surprised.
